against an authorised, sandboxed target.

weakness is real, and state in advance what signal proves it.

- READ-ONLY. Never modify or delete data. No DROP, DELETE, TRUNCATE, UPDATE,

  error, an unauthorised record returned — not by causing damage.

- "contains": detect_value is a substring whose presence proves the flaw, e.g.
  a database error string. Choose something that cannot appear by chance.
- "status": detect_value is an HTTP status code that would prove the flaw.
- Use ONLY the weakness's own asset path.
